facts.label: Time to platinum
facts.value: About 200 hours (PowerPyx); Push Square says up to 300+ hours if you take your time

facts.label: Playthroughs
facts.value: 1 — free roam continues after the story, but there is no mission replay

facts.label: Manual saves
facts.value: 15 slots — keep one at the start and end of every chapter

facts.label: Cheats
facts.value: Disable trophies and saving — keep them off your platinum save

stages.name: Play the story
steps: Play through all 5 chapters with Jason and Lucia. There are no mission gold medals to chase, so enjoy the campaign.

Do Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 before it ends — the only possibly missable trophy (Positive Mental Attitude). After the mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning, follow her to the balcony and accept.
Keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter. There is no mission replay, so saves are your only backup.
Take optional missions as they appear (purple icons, and black icons with pink letters) — they introduce robberies, fishing, hunting and other activities.
Scan every new vehicle with the WAiNK app and study new animals through your binoculars as you go: 100% needs 200 of 277 base vehicles and 100 of 255 animals.
stages.trophies: Story trophies (12) + the one missable warning

stages.name: The 100% completion checklist
steps: After the credits, open Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion. Everything you did during the story already counts toward it.
Clear every robbery: all gang operations, bank jobs, payday loan jobs, bank vaults and underwater discoveries. These are the only tasks that need everything.
Finish the collectibles the checklist asks for in part: 15 of 18 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 33 underwater discoveries, 100 of 125 Cocaine Flamingos.
Work the activities: 300 stunts, all 42 Shooting Range gold medals, all 42 drone time trials, 30 of 40 unique races won, 15 of 15 Bret target decks.
Complete 70 of the 80 challenges — you can skip the 10 hardest. PowerPyx notes the checklist is closer to 60% true completion, so do not hunt everything.
stages.trophies: A Long Road (gold) + most activities, collectibles and crime trophies

stages.name: Strangers & Freaks and cleanup
steps: Complete 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands across Leonida (Kirk, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete are confirmed to count).
Finish the character questlines: Andy (Lucia-only), Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone (Jason-only).
Mop up the remaining meditation spots for Positive Mental Attitude and any combat, driving or miscellaneous trophies left over.
Check your trophy list one last time — Vice Got a Price! pops as soon as the 54th other trophy does.

title: Roadmap to the Platinum
warnings: Avoid the Irredeemable criminal profile: it is permanent and makes police more aggressive. (PowerPyx)
Some optional missions expire and some fences disappear for good, but none of that blocks any trophy — every trophy-related character returns in free roam. (PowerPyx)
Cheats only unlock after the story, exactly when you will be mopping up most trophies — and they disable trophies and saving. Keep them off. (PowerPyx, GameMapa)
